classes.name: Bầu cử đại biểu Quốc hội
classes.locator: https://datafiles.chinhphu.vn/cpp/files/vbpq/2025/7/52-vbhn-vpqh.pdf (Article 7: universal, equal, direct, and secret election of deputies; Article 27: voting at 18, standing at 21; Article 71: five-year term, the new Assembly elected 60 days before the old one's term ends)
classes.finest_note: electoral unit (đơn vị bầu cử) of up to three seats within a province; each is divided into polling areas (khu vực bỏ phiếu), about 72,000 in 2026
classes.note: Sixteen elections from the general election of 6 January 1946 (held across the whole country for the Democratic Republic of Vietnam) through the northern elections of 1960-1975, in which the southern deputies of 1946 kept their seats, to the elections of the reunified country from 25 April 1976. Each province's constituencies elect one to three deputies by block vote: a voter strikes out the candidates they reject, and a candidate needs more than half of the valid ballots. Seats left empty go to a further ballot (bầu cử thêm) among the unsuccessful candidates within seven days, and a constituency where no more than half the voters voted votes again (bầu cử lại); electoral law arts. 79-80. Candidates are nominated through the Fatherland Front's consultative conferences, which settle the list before polling. The National Election Council (Hội đồng bầu cử quốc gia, constitution art. 117) announces the elected with each winner's votes by constituency; the votes of unsuccessful candidates and polling-area counts are kept by the provincial election committees and are not published nationally. The 2011 election was moved a year earlier to coincide with the councils, and the 2026 election was held on 15 March instead of in May.

cadence.administered_by: Hội đồng bầu cử quốc gia (National Election Council), with an election committee in each province
cadence.runoff_rule: A winner needs more than half of the valid ballots; seats left unfilled go to one further ballot among the unsuccessful candidates within seven days (art. 79), and a constituency where no more than half the registered voters voted votes again within seven days (art. 80)
cadence.vacancy_rule: By-election (bầu cử bổ sung) unless less than a year of the term remains

classes.locator: https://datafiles.chinhphu.vn/cpp/files/vbpq/2025/7/52-vbhn-vpqh.pdf (Article 87: the President is elected by the National Assembly from among its deputies, for the Assembly's term; Article 70(7): the Assembly elects the President and Vice President)
classes.note: The Assembly elects the President on a single nomination by secret ballot at its first session, and fills vacancies in mid-term (2024 twice). From 1981 to 1992 the head of state was the collective Council of State (Hội đồng Nhà nước), whose chair and members the Assembly elected; the 1992 constitution restored the President. The Assembly's resolution and the session's press releases give the votes in favor and the deputies present.

classes.locator: https://vanban.chinhphu.vn/default.aspx?pageid=27160&docid=183213 (the Assembly decides to hold a referendum on the constitution or an important national matter; constitution art. 29: citizens aged 18 vote in referendums the state holds)

classes.name: Hiệp thương, hội nghị cử tri giới thiệu người ứng cử
classes.name_en: Fatherland Front consultative conferences and voters' meetings that settle the candidate lists
classes.locator: https://pbgdpl.cantho.gov.vn/quy-dinh-so-luong-dai-bieu-quoc-hoi-va-dai-bieu-hoi-dong-nhan-dan (articles 8 and 9: the Standing Committee and the councils set the planned composition of deputies with the Fatherland Front; the Front's consultative conferences then settle the lists)
classes.disposition_reason: The candidate lists are settled by three rounds of consultative conferences of the Fatherland Front and by show-of-hands meetings of voters at candidates' homes and workplaces; these are not ballots of the electorate and no counts are published, so the archive records only the general elections they feed.

classes.disposition_reason: Delegate, Central Committee, and General Secretary elections are run under the Party's own charter; no state authority runs or certifies them.

classes.locator: https://datafiles.chinhphu.vn/cpp/files/vbpq/2025/7/52-vbhn-vpqh.pdf (Preamble: the struggle for independence and the reunification of the country in 1975-1976)
classes.disposition_reason: Held in the south by the State and then Republic of Vietnam (Constituent Assembly 1956 and 1966, National Assembly 1959 and 1963, Senate 1967, 1970, and 1973, House 1967 and 1971). No authority of the present state publishes their results; the Republic's gazette and election records are held by the National Archives Centre II in Ho Chi Minh City, which has no online catalog of them.

classes.disposition_reason: Direct presidential elections of the Republic of Vietnam in 1961, 1967, and 1971; no authority of the present state publishes their results, and the records are held by the National Archives Centre II without an online catalog.

classes.name: Trưng cầu dân ý 1955 (Quốc gia Việt Nam)
classes.name_en: State of Vietnam referendum of 23 October 1955 on the head of state
classes.disposition_reason: The single referendum of the State of Vietnam, which deposed the former emperor in favor of the prime minister and preceded the Republic; no authority of the present state publishes its result, and the records are held by the National Archives Centre II without an online catalog.

classes.name: Bầu cử đại biểu Hội đồng nhân dân cấp tỉnh
classes.name_en: Provincial and city People's Councils, directly elected
classes.locator: https://datafiles.chinhphu.vn/cpp/files/vbpq/2025/7/52-vbhn-vpqh.pdf (Article 113: the People's Council is elected by the local people; Article 7: universal, equal, direct, and secret ballot)
classes.finest_note: council constituency (đơn vị bầu cử) of up to five seats
classes.note: Councils of 50 to 85 deputies by population, 125 in Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City (local government law art. 30), elected by block vote with the same majority rule as the Assembly, except that a further ballot is held only when fewer than two thirds of a constituency's seats are filled (electoral law art. 79). Council elections were held on their own day until 2004 and have coincided with the Assembly's since 22 May 2011. Each provincial election committee announces its winners with their votes by resolution on the province's portal; there is no national publication of candidate votes. The 34 provincial councils elected in 2026 replaced the 63 elected in 2021.

cadence.administered_by: Ủy ban bầu cử ở tỉnh (provincial election committee), guided by the National Election Council
cadence.runoff_rule: A winner needs more than half of the valid ballots; a further ballot within seven days only if fewer than two thirds of the constituency's seats are filled (art. 79)

dates.note: Council elections under the Democratic Republic and the reunified state before they joined the Assembly's polling day, not yet counted here.

classes.name: Bầu cử đại biểu Hội đồng nhân dân cấp huyện
classes.locator: https://datafiles.chinhphu.vn/cpp/files/vbpq/2025/7/2025_807-808_72-2025-qh15..pdf (Article 51(3): the People's Councils and Committees of districts, urban districts, towns, and provincial cities end their activity from 1 July 2025)
classes.disposition_reason: Results were announced by each of some 700 district election committees on paper and on district portals, many of which closed with the district tier in 2025; no national or provincial publication of candidate votes exists.
classes.note: Elected with the provincial and commune councils, last on 23 May 2021. Councils of urban districts and wards were suspended in ten provinces and cities from 2009 to 2016 (Resolution 26/2008/QH12) and abolished in Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City, and Đà Nẵng from 2021 under their urban government laws.

classes.name: Hội đồng nhân dân cấp huyện bầu Chủ tịch Hội đồng nhân dân, Chủ tịch Ủy ban nhân dân
classes.name_en: District council chairs and People's Committee chairs, elected by the district council (abolished 2025)
classes.disposition_reason: Ballots of the district councils were minuted locally and never published with counts.

classes.name: Bầu cử đại biểu Hội đồng nhân dân cấp xã
classes.name_en: Commune, ward, and special zone People's Councils, directly elected
classes.locator: https://datafiles.chinhphu.vn/cpp/files/vbpq/2025/7/2025_807-808_72-2025-qh15..pdf (Article 1: communes, wards, and special zones form the second tier; Article 28: special zones under 1,000 residents have no council; Article 30(2): councils of 15 to 30 deputies by population)
classes.finest_note: council constituency of up to five seats within the commune
classes.disposition_reason: Each of the 3,321 commune election committees announces its winners with their votes on the commune's notice board and, for some, its portal; provinces publish only totals of deputies elected, and no source gathers the candidate votes.
classes.note: Before July 2025 the tier held some 10,000 communes, wards, and townships under the districts. Ward councils were suspended in ten provinces from 2009 to 2016 and abolished in Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City, and Đà Nẵng in 2021, and were restored in every ward by the 2025 law.

cadence.administered_by: Ủy ban bầu cử ở xã (commune election committee)

dates.note: Commune council elections before 2011 not yet counted here.

dates.quote: cử tri cả nước đã bầu đủ 500 đại biểu Quốc hội, 2.552 đại biểu HĐND cấp tỉnh và 72.440 đại biểu HĐND cấp xã

classes.name: Hội đồng nhân dân cấp xã bầu Chủ tịch Hội đồng nhân dân, Chủ tịch Ủy ban nhân dân
classes.name_en: Commune council chairs and People's Committee chairs, elected by the commune council
classes.disposition_reason: Minuted by each council and announced by name only; no publication of the counts.

classes.name: Bầu Trưởng thôn, Tổ trưởng tổ dân phố
classes.name_en: Hamlet heads and residential group heads, elected by the households
classes.locator: https://datafiles.chinhphu.vn/cpp/files/vbpq/2023/4/luat10.pdf (Article 15(4): the residential community decides the election and dismissal of the hamlet head and residential group head)
classes.disposition_reason: Held at a meeting or by ballot of the household representatives of each of the 48,078 hamlets and residential groups and reported to the commune People's Committee, which confirms the result; nothing is published.
